errors.text_span: 且“Our”模型在所有句长区间下的预测速度均显著高于“TreeLSTM”模型。
errors.evidence: The prompt instructs to avoid comparisons and conclusions. This part of the sentence compares the performance of the two models ('Our' vs 'TreeLSTM') and uses evaluative language ('显著高于' - significantly higher), which constitutes interpretation.
